profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Empower
profile.summary:
With over a decade in web development, I've honed a diverse skill set that spans from JavaScript intricacies to advanced front-end tools, including frameworks like React and Angular. My knack for transforming designs into interactive applications is founded on a strong grip over CSS and a backend foundation built around Node, Express, and a suite of databases from Postgres to MongoDB.

For me, the most enriching growth happens on the job. By immersing myself in real-world projects, I uncover new insights and techniques that textbooks might miss. I believe in the power of collaboration, and I value the shared wisdom that comes from working with a team. As I look ahead, I'm keen on diving deeper into the world of e-commerce and exploring innovative system designs. If you're passionate about creating and learning just as I am, I'd love to connect!
